presentation.description:
If you use Moradin's resolve with an attack that uses the weapon under the effects of your weapon of the dwarf-father power, you also deal 1d10 extra radiant and fire damage with that weapon until the end of your next turn. If the attack scores a critical hit, the target is also stunned until the end of your next turn.

Weapon of the Dwarf-FatherSoulforged Feature 11

Your weapon glows with the power of Moradin's forge.

At-Will   ✦     Divine, Fire, Radiant

Minor Action      Melee touch

Target: One weapon you are holding

Effect: Weapon attacks made with the target weapon deal fire and radiant damage instead of their normal damage types. Additionally, the weapon emits bright light in all squares within 15 squares of you. This effect lasts until you end it as a free action or until you end your turn and are not holding the target weapon.

presentation.description: You are tempered in the white flames of Moradin's forge and carry its fire into every strike. Spending an action point restores a spent Channel Divinity use or an encounter attack, and your weapon can blaze with fire and radiant light at will. A burning blast scorches nearby foes, an interrupt hardens you against danger, and your daily attack makes the ground around you hard to cross while your hits keep burning with extra Wisdom damage.

presentation.description:
Your weapon glows bright with the heat of the Soulforge. It hurtles into one enemy, and then releases a searing blast of celestial fire.

ENCOUNTER / STANDARD

Melee or Ranged weapon

Target: One creature

Primary Attack: Wisdom vs. AC

Hit: 2[W] + Wisdom fire and radiant damage.

Effect: Make a secondary attack.

Secondary Target: Each enemy within 3 squares of the primary target.

Secondary Attack: Wisdom vs. Fortitude

Hit: 1d8 + Wisdom fire and radiant damage, and the secondary target is dazed until the end of your next turn.

DAILY / STANDARD

Melee or Ranged weapon

Target: One creature

Hit: 2[W] + Wisdom fire and radiant damage.

Miss: Half damage.

Effect: Until the end of the encounter, your attacks deal extra fire and radiant damage equal to your Wisdom, and enemies treat all squares adjacent to you as difficult terrain.
